# PLAN — iteration 1
## Current state assessment
The incumbent is timing-feasible at 25 LUTs, 36 FFs, WNS 0.343 ns and WHS 0.14 ns, so promotion requires a strictly lower LUT count with all gates passing. The editable top is already a direct pass-through to the frozen core, which must remain an unconditional live instance; there is no apparent area-bearing logic in the top to remove.

## Hypothesis
Changing only this pass-through wrapper is unlikely to reduce LUT usage, so an iteration that preserves behavior should be expected to remain at 25 LUTs and will not qualify as an objective improvement.

## Instruction for generator
Keep the unconditional `spi_master_core #( .HALF_PERIOD(2) ) u_spi_master_core` instance and its direct port connections; they already implement the required wrapper with no visible extra logic. No behavior-preserving top-only transformation is apparent that can reduce mapped LUTs while keeping that instance live and driving the outputs. Report this scope limitation rather than changing cycle behavior or claiming an unmeasured gain.
